sloka: न ध्वजा न पताका वा चर्म वा तुरगो ऽपि वा ।आयुधं स्यन्दनं वा ऽपि ददृशे तेन रेणुना ।। ६.५५.२० ।।।।
transliteration: na dhvajā na patākā vā carma vā turago 'pi vā ।āyudhaṁ syandanaṁ vā 'pi dadṛśe tena reṇunā ।। 6.55.20 ।।।।

translations.english: By the dust raised, the posts, flags, shields and not even horses, weapons and chariots were visible.
